items.title: Lawrence Duhé Interview, 1957-06-09
items.q: Did you ever know Bill Johnson and Dink Johnson?

ctx.x: Oh, he's still in New Iberia. Or the piano. He's in Los Angeles. William Boyner. Burnham? B-R-N-E-R. Burner. Yeah. Burner. Oh, I knew something like that. Burner played sax. A friend of Dink Johnson. Did you ever know Bill Johnson and Dink Johnson? I know Dink. I know Dink Johnson. He's dead now, too. That's Ed Reedom. He's dead. The banjo is Ed Reedom.
